# Mechanism illustration: lag correlation and prevalence by occasion, scenario M1, H0 ("manual"),
# one large dataset per replicate per mechanism, generators of the study used unchanged (read-only repo).
.libPaths("~/MMM/renv/library/linux-ubuntu-noble/R-4.6/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu")
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1")
source(path.expand("~/MMM/R/s3/s3_common.R"))          # load_env, set_rep_seed, RUNDIR_V4, DGPS (no writes at source time)
COP_DIR <- file.path(RUNDIR_V4, "copula")
load_env_cop <- function() {                             # verbatim file list of R/s7e/s7e_common.R::load_env_cop
  env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
  for (f in c("copula_params.R", "gen_copula_data.R", "generation_models_copula.R")) sys.source(file.path(COP_DIR, f), envir = env)
  for (f in c("manual/generate_data.R", "ar1/make_all_data.R")) sys.source(file.path(RUNDIR_V4, f), envir = env)
  env
}
N <- 2000L; TT <- 10L; NREP <- 10L; MODEL <- 1L; LABEL <- "manual"
MECH <- c("GenBinaryY", "GLMM-native", "GLMM-AR1", "Copula-AR1")
gen_one <- function(m, i) {
  env <- if (m == "Copula-AR1") load_env_cop() else load_env(m, RUNDIR_V4)
  set_rep_seed(MODEL, i)
  t0 <- proc.time()[[3]]
  d <- as.data.frame(env$make_all_data(N, TT, i, MODEL, LABEL))
  d <- d[order(d$id, d$time), c("id", "time", "trt", "binY")]
  list(m = m, i = i, d = d, secs = proc.time()[[3]] - t0,
       par = if (m == "Copula-AR1") c(rho = env$COPULA_RHO, floor = env$COPULA_FLOOR)
             else if (m == "GLMM-AR1") c(rho = env$AR1_RHO, sigma2 = env$AR1_SIGMA2) else NA)
}
jobs <- expand.grid(i = seq_len(NREP), m = MECH, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), function(k) tryCatch(gen_one(jobs$m[k], jobs$i[k]), error = function(e) list(m = jobs$m[k], i = jobs$i[k], err = conditionMessage(e))),
                          mc.cores = 4L, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
errs <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x$err), res)
if (length(errs)) { for (e in errs) cat("GEN ERROR", e$m, e$i, e$err, "\n") }
res <- Filter(function(x) is.null(x$err), res)
cat("generated:", length(res), "datasets; secs per dataset:", paste(sprintf("%s=%.1f", sapply(res, `[[`, "m"), sapply(res, `[[`, "secs")), collapse = " "), "\n")
for (x in res[!duplicated(sapply(res, `[[`, "m"))]) cat("params", x$m, paste(names(x$par), x$par, collapse = " "), "\n")

pair_rows <- list(); prev_rows <- list(); pool_rows <- list(); info <- list()
for (x in res) {
  d <- x$d
  W <- matrix(NA_integer_, N, TT); W[cbind(d$id, d$time + 1L)] <- d$binY
  arm <- d$trt[!duplicated(d$id)][order(unique(d$id))]
  info[[length(info) + 1]] <- data.frame(mechanism = x$m, rep = x$i, n_subj = length(unique(d$id)), n_obs = nrow(d), mean_y = mean(d$binY))
  for (j in 1:TT) for (a in 0:1) { y <- W[arm == a, j]; y <- y[!is.na(y)]
    prev_rows[[length(prev_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(mechanism = x$m, rep = x$i, occasion = j - 1L, arm = a, n = length(y), y1 = sum(y)) }
  for (L in 1:(TT - 1)) {
    pa <- c(); pb <- c()
    for (j in 1:(TT - L)) { k <- j + L
      for (a in 0:1) { ok <- arm == a & !is.na(W[, j]) & !is.na(W[, k])
        ya <- W[ok, j]; yb <- W[ok, k]
        r <- if (sd(ya) > 0 && sd(yb) > 0) cor(ya, yb) else NA_real_
        pair_rows[[length(pair_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(mechanism = x$m, rep = x$i, lag = L, occ_j = j - 1L, occ_k = k - 1L, arm = a, n = sum(ok), r = r) }
      ok <- !is.na(W[, j]) & !is.na(W[, k]); pa <- c(pa, W[ok, j]); pb <- c(pb, W[ok, k]) }
    pool_rows[[length(pool_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(mechanism = x$m, rep = x$i, lag = L, n_pairs = length(pa), r_pooled = cor(pa, pb))
  }
}
pairs <- do.call(rbind, pair_rows); prev <- do.call(rbind, prev_rows); pool <- do.call(rbind, pool_rows); info <- do.call(rbind, info)
write.csv(pairs, "mech_pair_corr.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(prev, "mech_prev_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pool, "mech_pooled_corr.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(info, "mech_dataset_info.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("pairs rows", nrow(pairs), " NA r:", sum(is.na(pairs$r)), "\n")
print(aggregate(r ~ mechanism + lag, data = pairs, FUN = mean))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
d='hpc/bd4c4d3b-c029-4ae2-a73b-4513a1b65561/'
pairs=pd.read_csv(d+'mech_pair_corr.csv'); prev=pd.read_csv(d+'mech_prev_counts.csv'); pool=pd.read_csv(d+'mech_pooled_corr.csv'); info=pd.read_csv(d+'mech_dataset_info.csv')
# per replicate: n-weighted mean of pair/arm-specific correlations at each lag
rep=pairs.groupby(['mechanism','rep','lag']).apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'r':np.average(g.r,weights=g.n),'n_pairs':g.n.sum()})).reset_index()
lagt=rep.groupby(['mechanism','lag']).agg(r_mean=('r','mean'),r_sd=('r','std'),n_rep=('r','size'),n_pairs_total=('n_pairs','sum')).reset_index()
lagt['mcse']=lagt.r_sd/np.sqrt(lagt.n_rep); lagt['lo']=lagt.r_mean-2*lagt.mcse; lagt['hi']=lagt.r_mean+2*lagt.mcse
pl=pool.groupby(['mechanism','lag']).r_pooled.mean().reset_index()
lagt=lagt.merge(pl,on=['mechanism','lag'])
pr=prev.groupby(['mechanism','rep','occasion'])[['n','y1']].sum().reset_index(); pr['p']=pr.y1/pr.n
prt=pr.groupby(['mechanism','occasion']).agg(prev_mean=('p','mean'),prev_sd=('p','std'),n_rep=('p','size'),n_obs_total=('n','sum')).reset_index()
prt['mcse']=prt.prev_sd/np.sqrt(prt.n_rep); prt['lo']=prt.prev_mean-2*prt.mcse; prt['hi']=prt.prev_mean+2*prt.mcse
# by arm too
pa=prev.groupby(['mechanism','occasion','arm'])[['n','y1']].sum().reset_index(); pa['p']=pa.y1/pa.n
print(lagt.pivot(index='lag',columns='mechanism',values='r_mean').round(3))
print(lagt.mcse.max().round(4), (lagt.r_mean-lagt.r_pooled).abs().max().round(3))
print(prt.pivot(index='occasion',columns='mechanism',values='prev_mean').round(3))
print(info.groupby('mechanism')[['n_subj','n_obs','mean_y']].mean())
